summary: App needs an in-app Super Admin dashboard for the first/initial user (super admin) to review new user signup details and approve/reject accounts; new signups should show a pending approval message until approved.
architectural_notes: Treat the first registered account as Super Admin (or define a super-admin assignment rule) and gate admin dashboard access accordingly.

existing_features.title: Ensure the first registered user (role: "super_admin") can access an in-app Super Admin dashboard from the profile/avatar menu, without relying on Firebase Auth displayName/photoURL (use Firestore `users/{uid}.role` only).
Implement/confirm an Admin Users approval screen that lets super admins review full signup details for each pending user and approve/reject them from within the app.
Ensure that newly signed-up or newly logged-in unapproved users see an in-app pending message that clearly states the account is pending admin approval (use English user-facing text).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add Super Admin dashboard accessible from profile for the first user (super admin)
Implement user approval workflow: view new user signup details and approve/reject users from admin dashboard
Show 'Pending approval for admin' message/status to newly signed-up users until approved

projectName: Add in-app Super Admin dashboard access and pending-user approval flow
